51: @Log4j2

53: @EnableWebSecurity
54: @RequiredArgsConstructor

56: public class SecurityConfig {
57: 
58:     private static final String[] AUTH_WHITELIST = {
59:             // -- Swagger UI v2
60:             "/v2/api-docs", "/swagger-resources", "/swagger-resources/**", "/configuration/ui", "/configuration/security", "/swagger-ui.html", "/webjars/**",
61:             // -- Swagger UI v3 (OpenAPI)
62:             "/v3/api-docs/**", "/swagger-ui/**", "/",
63:             // other public endpoints of your API may be appended to this array
64:             "/actuator/**",};
65: 
66:     private static final List<String> CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS =
67:             List.of("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "Authorization", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Origin,Accept", "X-Requested-With",
68:                     "Content-Type", "Access-Control-Request-Method", "Access-Control-Request-Headers");
69: 
70:     private final Environment env;
71:     private final KeycloakLogoutHandler keycloakLogoutHandler;
72:     private final Converter hellodataAuthenticationConverter; //NOSONAR
73: 
74:     @Value("${hello-data.cors.allowed-origins}")
75:     private String allowedOrigins;
76: 
77:     @PostConstruct
78:     public void init() {
79:         log.info("[CORS configuration] List of allowed origins {}", allowedOrigins);
80:         log.info("[CORS configuration] List of allowed headers {}", CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS);
81:     }
82: 
83:     @Bean
84:     public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
85:         configureFrameOptions(http);
86:         configureCors(http);
87:         configureCsrf(http);
88:         http.authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> {
89:             AntPathRequestMatcher[] matchers = new AntPathRequestMatcher[AUTH_WHITELIST.length]; //NOSONAR
90:             for (int i = 0; i < AUTH_WHITELIST.length; i++) {
91:                 matchers[i] = new AntPathRequestMatcher(AUTH_WHITELIST[i]); //NOSONAR
92:             }
93:             auth.requestMatchers(matchers).permitAll();
94:             auth.anyRequest().authenticated();
95:         });
96:         http.oauth2Login(withDefaults());
97:         http.logout(httpSecurityLogoutConfigurer -> httpSecurityLogoutConfigurer.addLogoutHandler(keycloakLogoutHandler).logoutSuccessUrl("/"));
98:         http.oauth2ResourceServer(httpSecurityOAuth2ResourceServerConfigurer -> httpSecurityOAuth2ResourceServerConfigurer.jwt(
99:                 jwtConfigurer -> jwtConfigurer.jwtAuthenticationConverter(hellodataAuthenticationConverter)));
100:         return http.build();
101:     }
102: 
103:     private void configureCsrf(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
104:         if (env.matchesProfiles("disable-csrf")) {
105:             http.csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable()); //NOSONAR
106:         } else {
107:             http.csrf(withDefaults());
108:         }
109:     }
110: 
111:     private void configureFrameOptions(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
112:         if (env.matchesProfiles("disable-frame-options")) {
113:             http.headers(headers -> headers.frameOptions(HeadersConfigurer.FrameOptionsConfig::disable));
114:         } else {
115:             http.headers(headers -> headers.frameOptions(HeadersConfigurer.FrameOptionsConfig::deny));//backend is not embedded into iframe
116:         }
117:     }
118: 
119:     private void configureCors(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
120:         if (env.matchesProfiles("disable-cors")) {
121:             http.cors(cors -> cors.disable()); //NOSONAR
122:         } else {
123:             List<String> allowedOriginList = Arrays.stream(allowedOrigins.split(",")).toList();
124: 
125:             http.cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(request -> {
126:                 CorsConfiguration corsConfig = new CorsConfiguration();
127:                 if (!allowedOriginList.isEmpty()) {
128:                     for (String allowedOrigin : allowedOriginList) {
129:                         corsConfig.addAllowedOrigin(allowedOrigin);
130:                     }
131:                 } else {
132:                     corsConfig.addAllowedOrigin("*"); //NOSONAR
133:                 }
134:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("GET");
135:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("POST");
136:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("PUT");
137:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("DELETE");
138:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("PATCH");
139:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("HEAD");
140:                 corsConfig.addAllowedMethod("OPTIONS");
141: 
142:                 corsConfig.setAllowedHeaders(CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS);
143:                 corsConfig.setMaxAge(3600L);
144:                 corsConfig.setExposedHeaders(List.of("xsrf-token"));
145:                 return corsConfig;
146:             }));
147:         }
148:     }
149: }

steps.message:
Implemented the Spring Boot 4 migration.

Changed:
- Upgraded `spring-boot.version` to `4.0.3`.
- Updated Spring Cloud to `2025.1.0`.
- Moved project Java version properties to `21`.
- Updated Spring Boot 4 / Spring 7 package moves:
  - actuator health
  - entity scanning
  - endpoint request matching
  - error controller
  - security authorization manager
- Updated Spring Cloud Gateway starter artifacts.
- Updated Spring Framework 7 `HttpHeaders` and URI builder API usage.
- Adjusted Redis cache configuration for the custom cache manager.
- Added Boot 4 test starter dependencies for webmvc/data-jpa test slices.

Verification:
- `./mvnw -DskipTests compile` passes for the full reactor.
- `./mvnw test` still fails at test compilation because existing test files import old Boot 3 packages such as `org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.*`. I did not modify test files per constraint.
